results.title: to be judged
results.overview: "In this society, you’ve already lost anyway—I’m just not white, I’m not cis, I’m not hetero," says Gem. Together with Naomi, Gem is part of Munich’s vibrant Ballroom scene—a queer subculture historically pioneered by Black and Latinx trans women. Here, in a world flipped on its head, being outside the white, cis-heteronormative box isn't the exception; it's the norm. It is a vital sanctuary of celebration, free from stares, slurs, or the constant need to justify one's existence.  But as the night unfolds, the boundaries between escapism and harsh reality blur. In the category of Realness, trans individuals compete to see who blends best into a cis-normative world—a survival skill judged as an art form. Why do these safe spaces actively replicate the very judgments of the outside world, and how did they become a chosen home? Through raw, intimate access to Naomi and Gem, this documentary explores the heart, joy, and deep-rooted complexities of Munich’s Ballroom community.

results.title: Megh |06|
results.overview: If thoughts opened up onto dreams, one would look up and see in a cloud resting on the hill crest, an elephant poised to butt a riverbank. Handmade crystals of argentum painted on old acetate in the dark. Hopes of seeing the light. Falls back apart on itself. An utterance of royal poet: for fame home left bids cloud voyage journey sail sky far away. Emulsion cracks, base cracks, held by tape on both sides. Palm leaves crumble and 4K scans are pointless, dust gets in anyway. When it rains snakes crawl up into the spines of trees and look closely when the lightning strikes you can see their scales shine in the moonlight.

results.title: Remains Unsaid
results.overview: Remains Unsaid is a non-film created using a laser engraver. While scanning my late brother’s poetry to disseminate to family, I was fascinated with the overlapping text inherent in the editing process and the visual anomalies created by the Underwood-Olivetti typewriter. This moving image artwork is an assemblage of these artifacts, printed on transparency paper and cut into 16mm strips. The audio was captured from a projection of the film on an Eiki Slim Line.

results.title: Woolf: Un Cuarto Propio en Bogotá
results.original_title: Woolf: Un Cuarto Propio en Bogotá
results.overview: An experimental portrait of the intellectual spirit, energy and story behind a bookstore named after Virginia Woolf in Bogotá, Colombia. Shot on 16mm film that was hand-processed at La Javeriana (Pontificia Universidad Javeriana) and funded by a 2023 Fulbright U.S. Scholar Award.

results.title: bearing fruit of fondness, Grounds of Coherence #2
results.original_title: bearing fruit of fondness, Grounds of Coherence #2
results.overview: Filmed in Northern Isle of Skye, bearing fruit of fondness is a 16mm black and white film hand processed with a type of invasive cotoneaster that is native to Eastern Asia, brought to the UK in the 19th century as an ornamental plant. Working with elemental kinship, the process guides a capacity to relate to pain while grounded in the understanding of interdependence, where concept of belonging erodes through patterns of mother-child relationships that extend to nation and citizen, land and dweller. The film features a single-take vocal performance of the script in Chinese by Shen Xin, interspersed with breath and stillness against the Southwest storms heard from their home.

results.title: Emoo'u This is not my Home
results.overview: emoo'u means "my home" in the indigenous Cou language. In 2009, Typhoon Morakot hit Shanmei Village in Alishan. The storm destroyed our roads, bridge, and homes. Using old and new videos, this documentary shows how our village rebuilt itself after the disaster. Originally, the government planned to move residents from the high-risk zone down to permanent housing outside our mountains. Eventually, we were allowed to stay, and the government built permanent housing for us on a safer site inside our village, which was completed in 2011. In this new neighborhood, life went on—people talked to each other, and a bread van visited from the city. For my mother, the new house was a fresh start and a real home where she felt free. But for me, it did not feel like home.

results.title: Smooth World
results.overview: Unseen since its exodus from the radio, the critically-loathed world of Smooth Jazz has evolved into a joy-filled paradise for senior citizens. Facing extinction, its artists and fans band together to find a new leader that can save the Smooth World.

results.title: Jeju Olle
results.overview: After losing her beloved cousin and longtime manager, Indian star Alisha steps away from the spotlight and travels to Jeju Island to fulfill a promise they once made together. There, she unexpectedly crosses paths with Ha Sun-woo, a former K-pop idol and singer-songwriter who has retreated to Jeju after his own career and confidence were shaken by the past. What begins as a chaotic misunderstanding gradually turns into an unexpected connection. Over the course of a week, Alisha and Sun-woo explore Jeju's breathtaking landscapes, share music, laughter, and quiet moments, and slowly begin to open up about the wounds they have kept hidden from the world.

results.title: American Showdown 8 - Eine wahre Geschichte
results.overview: In the 1990s, five boys from East Berlin discover a passion for American action movies. They begin filming their own seven-part action series, "American Showdown"—shooting "guerilla-style" without permits. Years later, now adults, they reunite to revive their dream. They shoot the eighth installment of the series just as they did back then: on a shoestring budget and with plenty of passion. However, their ambitions and expectations have grown, and the filmmaking process puts their friendship to the ultimate test.

results.title: The Informant
results.overview: Eighty-two-year-old Juris Kalniņš has found his name in the archives of the Committee for State Security of the Latvian SSR, where he is identified as an informant. Both during the Soviet era and today, he remains an uncompromising free thinker who has devoted most of his life to photographing people and documenting the spirit of the times. With the camera now turned towards Juris, he is ready to delve into his past to understand how his name could have ended up on a KGB file. What makes a person an informant – a piece of paper, mere suspicion, the opinions of others, or one’s own actions?

results.title: yolo
results.overview: The director finds herself torn between her newfound role as a mother and the loss of her own place as a daughter while caring for her dying mother, in an intimate portrait of life starting and ending, and of how loss can become the foundation for new beginnings.

results.title: Aroma de Baunilha
results.overview: In a game of desire, obsession, and flesh, *Aroma de Baunilha* reveals that true horror never arrives without an invitation.

results.title: Never Crossed the Mind
results.overview: In the heart of Luxor, Younes embarks on a romantic and comedic adventure when he becomes in charge of a multinational tourist group. While he tries to communicate with them in four different languages, he falls in love with a girl in the middle of ancient temples, and encounters funny situations that prove that the language of the heart is the truest, no matter how different the tongues are.

results.title: On March 12 And Every Day After
results.original_title: Am 12. März Und Alle Tage Danach
results.overview: A STORY ABOUT LOVE AND VIOLENCE. Linz, 12 March 1938: Milena, a young communist, is in a secret relationship with the seamstress Anne. Faced with the Austrofascist government under Schuschnigg and the Nazi invasion, she is at a loss as to whether she should stay with Anne in Linz or return to her family in Southern Carinthia. As she is trying to figure out what to do, she meets Johann, a soldier in the Wehrmacht, who is very keen to get to know her better.
